commonProcedure.cast: Action; V,S,F; base26RP; exact Cleric/Wizard rank9 at class17+ with actual known/prepared acquisition. All five use Divination. Cosmic Revelation range100ft; others120ft. Check real living/capable caster, Action, audible V, usable S hand, focus custody, target/point range and LoE before paying. Choose targets and queries publicly without testing secret answerability. Hidden protection/unknown content resolves after commitment without a diagnostic. Pay strain-adjusted RP, update actual class Dissonance/Refrain, then permit actual source-qualified Counterspell reactions last-in first-out. A paid failed/countered cast refunds nothing. No general Overcast or free acquired spell.
commonProcedure.resources: Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,castMod)); read pre-cast D. At L/L+3/L+6 add1/2/3RP; at L+6 ordinary ranked casting blocked. BaseD2 for rank9; Refrain increases0/1/2/3 for successive same-family casts, capped3; idle turns do not reset Refrain. A different named spell breaks Refrain. Actual no-Weave regular turns vent1 Dissonance at end. Wizard Spell Efficiency discounts the next same prepared matrix within its real next-turn deadline by1RP (minimum1); acquired Arcane Feedback restores1RP only after a successful actual Counterspell. Knowledge Shield adds2 to the next qualifying ally save within its original deadline. Wizard first prepared family baseD0 only; no Refrain exemption. Cleric ordinary spell generates normal strain; no Conviction vent without actual qualifying Rite/Invocation expenditure. Optional class features are not automatically spent.
commonProcedure.truth: Keep authoritative fact versions, their actual sources, private memory/belief versions, institutional records, divine-channel answers and conditional forecasts in different records. A software log is evidence, not a character sense or omniscient validation channel. Actual Director-established facts can be inputs without a database, but no invented source, lore, faction roster or missing formula is a positive witness. Nonexistent established facts differ from unprovided facts.
commonProcedure.audience: Director audit stores full evidence privately. Recipient data contains only legitimately disclosed payloads, their observation time and permitted provenance. No total queried event count, hidden IDs, gaps, negative roster certification or reasons for unavailable results. Independent readable records can give historical reports about a protected subject; never validate those through the protected current subject. No new spell grants sight, LoE, proficiency, faction membership, standing or command.
commonProcedure.defenses: Protection from Scrying is new-information protection about its actual subject, not blanket immunity to every Divination consequence. Seal Vision blocks actual Divination components at its exact operator/recipient/observation loci. Abjuration Mind Blank blocks fresh bearer information and actual mind-affecting spell components; do not import its unacquired Enchantment/Universal modes. Antimagic uses current149 input/output and clocks. Condition-only immunity blocks only its condition. Source-specific immunity cannot be replaced with a generic rank9 bypass. No pending MD196/AG190/TF192/CC194 proposal supplies a defense or permission.
commonProcedure.clocks: The cases use the accepted equal-cost orthogonal/diagonal grid metric in three axes and actual occupied-body intersection; the recorded casting anchor fixes the center. No new off-grid geometry system is approved. All regular starts/ends remain actor-specific6second schedules. Record action/bonus/reaction refresh and spending, recharge and Ready expiry at each actual start. Extra Actions, source pulses and copied effects are not regular turns. Absolute deadlines and original regular markers persist through absence, modes, initiative reorder and suppression. Death/lifecycle rules and source dependencies apply separately. No die result or action is generated merely to fill a clock.
commonProcedure.knowledgeAftermath: Once legitimately acquired, knowledge is ordinary timestamped memory, not an ongoing Divination feed. Later dispel/Null/Seal does not erase the historical learning. Current accepted Mind Wipe may hide its captured accessible memories; preserve full original versions and later new experiences. Removal reveals only that seal's still-valid captured versions, never a global reset. Held Mind Collapse/Unravel Identity supply no joint restoration rule.
commonProcedure.research: Payload comprehension is explicit. Generic revelation grants no skill, Advanced mark, library receipt, missing Equation text or automatic Hunt. Equivalent genuinely functional dangerous knowledge, if source-authorized, invokes the actual separate KT/PT and warning/commitment/Hunt interfaces. No positive functional Equation payload is fabricated here; that content branch remains held. Q6 ceiling, unresolved identities, current owner corrections and staged revelation remain controlling.
commonProcedure.persistence: Persist casts, commitments, source IDs/ranks/schools, clocks, query slot states, protection inputs, subject/object custody, complete fact and memory versions and public/private output separately. Authored save/load JSON roundtrips and inverses demonstrate static preservation only; no engine/game execution or implementation approval.

procedureContent.selection: NEW OE198-QUERY: declare three nonadaptive Boolean propositions before commitment. The caster is the questioner and chooses one willing perceived recipient within120ft and LoE, including self. Actual questions may concern identified current/past facts on the same plane beyond120ft; range governs delivery, not invented omniscience of arbitrary cross-plane/private cosmology. This extension is local authorship. Use a language the questioner and recipient actually understand. The native divine truth channel attests supported answers without assigning a named patron, being, realm or universal omniscience.
procedureContent.validation: Public syntax validation before payment permits clarification of ambiguous referents, explicit time and compound logical operators; no interrogation of hidden existence/availability. Self-referential/paradoxical strings are not valid propositions. A false-presupposition question is rewritten explicitly as an existential conjunction, not answered with a misleading premise. Hidden nonexistence is tested only after payment. Well-formed AND/OR/NOT yields one bit, not subsidiary answers. No question may demand unmade free choices or ungenerated dice as settled truth.
procedureContent.answers: At one observation timestamp, produce exactly one slot record per proposition. If its truth is established, current, lawful and unprotected, answer Yes or No truthfully and usefully. NEW unsupported, protected, unassigned or genuinely contingent propositions consume their slot with the identical neutral No answer; no diagnostic or replacement query. This qualified failure contract is not Commune's symbolic answer substituted for valid questions. A supported false proposition returns No, distinguished from No answer. Existence-protected queries never reveal masked rosters by differences in output wording, timing or answer counts.
procedureContent.knowledge: Deliver only the three final permitted results privately; retain full canonical propositions, source fact versions and private evaluation evidence for audit. A question about a witness's prior reported belief can be answered as that belief if lawful; it must not certify a protected subject's current truth. A memory loss does not make an objectively established independent world event cease to exist, but no source-free reconstruction of erased private memory is granted. Repeat equivalent unchanged queries give stable answers; actual changed facts receive new versions, never rewrite earlier answers.
procedureContent.lifecycle: Instantaneous, no concentration or live relationship. No daily cap, deity favor check, new material, punishment or guaranteed destiny. Only lawful cast costs apply; countering or postcommitment unanswerability refunds none. Received knowledge uses normal recall/actual later communication. No forecast becomes a commanded future; unavailable lore and Q6/revelation exceptions remain held.
